resources.string: Each check gets a score from 0 to 100. That score is multiplied by the check’s share, and the points are added together.
Middle value %1$s · range %2$s to %3$s · inside in %4$d of %5$d reps
No score: the camera measured %1$d%% of this drill’s checks by weight. It needs %2$d%%.
The camera measured %1$d%% of this drill’s checks by weight (needs %2$d%%).
No check was measured in at least %1$d reps, so nothing was scored.

A rep scores 100 on a check inside the range and loses points evenly outside it. A check counts after %1$d measured reps; unmeasured checks are left out, not scored zero. The ranges are provisional until coaches review them.
